nodes.question: How do Indigenous-led practices contribute to biodiversity management according to the sources referenced?
nodes.answer: Indigenous-led practices play a crucial role in biodiversity management by integrating traditional ecological knowledge and enhancing conservation efforts in various ecosystems.
